Class AbstractMultiTenantServerTest

java.lang.Object
org.a2aproject.sdk.extras.multitenancy.tests.AbstractMultiTenantServerTest
public abstract class AbstractMultiTenantServerTest extends Object
Transport-agnostic multitenancy server test driven through the real A2A Client. Concrete @QuarkusTest subclasses implement the three transport hooks and each carry exactly one transport's reference module on the classpath.

    • getTransportUrl

      protected abstract String getTransportUrl()
      Base URL/target the client uses to reach the server. Must encode the same port passed to this class's constructor (e.g. "http://localhost:" + TEST_PORT, or "localhost:" + TEST_PORT for gRPC's schemeless target) — the two are not derived from each other.
